text: The attached Bulletin summarizes the results of the 2025 Toronto Employment Survey, the 43rd annual survey, highlighting key findings and counts of employment and business establishments in Toronto, such as: - In 2025, the Toronto Employment Survey recorded 1,623,710 jobs citywide, marking a new record high. - Full-time employment increased by 24,940 jobs from 2024 to 1,243,620 jobs while part-time employment decreased by 1,530 jobs to 380,090 jobs. - There are 74,560 establishments, a net increase of 1,380 or 1.9% over 2024. - The Office category continued to make up the largest share of Toronto employment, with 50.1% of jobs. - Downtown has a total of 664,650 jobs, exceeding last year's record high and representing 40.9% of the city’s total employment. - Employment Areas contained 21,440 establishments or 28.8% of the city total and 381,270 jobs or 23.5% of the city total. -…
